profile.reading: This is QGEN01, a data center at Via Isonzo 21 in Genoa, Italy, developed by Quadrivium Digital, a carrier neutral data center and subsea cable landing infrastructure company founded in 2022 and headquartered in London, United Kingdom. Quadrivium acquired the site, formerly a Banca Carige data center, in June 2022, and formally announced the redevelopment project in September 2024. The building spans about 9,000 square meters, or roughly 96,900 square feet, offering about 12 megawatts of IT power, engineered to Tier IV resilience standards for its power feed entry, or PFE, area handling subsea cable landing infrastructure, and Tier III plus resilience for its interconnection and general IT workload areas. Quadrivium markets the site as Genoas first purpose built, carrier neutral hub, providing cable landing as a service capable of supporting up to 8 submarine cable systems through a marine borepipe and beach landing at nearby Sturla beach, alongside colocation, interconnection, and two international internet exchange points, positioning Genoa as a new Mediterranean gateway for Europe, Asia, and Africa traffic alongside more established hubs such as Marseille and Frankfurt. Italian fiber and colocation operator Retelit has partnered with Quadrivium to launch a strategic point of presence at the site. Full operational status was originally targeted for the fourth quarter of 2025 but had slipped to a summer 2026 target as of sourcing checked this session.
